command: python -c 'import json; tasks=json.load(open("data/tasks.json")); completed=[t for t in tasks if t["status"]=="completed"]; print(f"Report: {len(completed)} tasks completed")'

description: Clean up temporary and cache files
command: rm -rf data/cache/* data/temp/* 2>/dev/null && echo 'Cleanup completed successfully'

patterns.command: tar -czf data/archives/task_outputs.tar.gz data/output/*.json 2>/dev/null && echo 'Archive created successfully'

python -c 'import csv; with open("data/metrics.csv", "w") as f: writer=csv.writer(f); writer.writerow(["task_id", "status", "duration"]); [writer.writerow([t["id"], t["status"], t["duration"]]) for t in tasks]; print("Metrics CSV generated")'

columns.description: Remove old log files beyond retention policy
columns.command: find data/logs -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null && echo 'Old logs removed successfully'
python -c 'import json; outputs=json.load(open("data/outputs.json")); assert all(o["valid"] for o in outputs); print("All outputs validated successfully")'
